findings.title: Security Advisory Bulletin 064
findings.summary_md: Ubiquiti's advisory, published May 21, 2026 and updated to version 1.1 on May 22, 2026, covers five CVEs across the UniFi OS family: CVE-2026-33000 (CVSS 9.1), CVE-2026-34908 and CVE-2026-34909 (both CVSS 10.0), CVE-2026-34910 (CVSS 10.0), and CVE-2026-34911 (CVSS 7.7). It lists UniFi OS Server 5.0.6 and earlier as affected, fixes in 5.0.8, and gives per-product fixed versions across the hardware lineup (5.1.12 for most gateways and recorders, 5.1.10 for UNAS, 5.1.11 for UDM-Beast, 4.0.14 for Express). Credited researchers include Duc Anh Nguyen, Abdulaziz Almadhi of Catchify Security, John Carroll, V3rlust, and Hakai Security.

findings.title: Popping Root on UniFi OS Server: Unauthenticated RCE Chain Detection & Analysis
findings.summary_md: Bishop Fox (Jon Williams) validated the full unauthenticated chain end to end against UniFi OS Server 5.0.6: an Nginx raw-versus-normalized URI mismatch riding the /api/auth/validate-sso/ exemption reaches the package-update command injection, and the ucs-update account's passwordless sudo over dpkg, chmod, systemctl, and uos escalates one request to a root shell. The post confirms forged HS256 owner tokens built from the signing key at /data/unifi-core/config/jwt.yaml still authenticate against fully patched 5.0.8 consoles, and publishes a safe detection tool, CVE-2026-34908-check, on GitHub.

findings.title: Looting UniFi Controllers: Detecting and Weaponizing CVE-2026-22557
findings.summary_md: A week before the UniFi OS Server chain writeup, Bishop Fox published analysis of CVE-2026-22557, a CVSS 10.0 unauthenticated path traversal in UniFi Network Application that exposes controller backups and the credentials of every managed device. The post covers a separate CVE from SAB-064 but is the second CVSS 10.0 in the UniFi ecosystem the same firm disclosed within two weeks.
